description: Malaysian affordable housing - 3 bedroom single storey

rule_priority.1_vision_ai: Grid dimensions from Vision API are PRIMARY source
rule_priority.2_preset_pattern: Layout pattern (which rooms where) from preset
rule_priority.3_minimum_override: Only override if dimension is functionally impossible

layout_pattern.circulation: Living hall is main circulation, bedrooms open to it
layout_pattern.kitchen: Back-center, SEPARATE room with door to dining
layout_pattern.bedrooms: Left side (master) and right side (bed 1, bed 2)

rule_1.name: LEFT_VERTICAL
rule_1.description: Separates left rooms from center hall
rule_1.position: At grid column B (or adjusted if bathroom too narrow)
rule_1.extent: From back wall (Y=0) to front row (Y=-6.4)

rule_2.name: RIGHT_VERTICAL
rule_2.description: Separates right bedrooms from center hall
rule_2.extent: From back wall (Y=0) to front row (Y=-6.4)

rule_3.name: BACK_HORIZONTAL
rule_3.description: Separates kitchen/wet areas from living areas
rule_3.extent: From left wall (X=0) to column D (NOT full width - BILIK 1 extends back)

rule_4.name: BILIK_DIVIDER
rule_4.description: Divides BILIK 1 from BILIK 2 on right side
rule_4.extent: From column D to right wall

rule_5.name: FRONT_SEGMENTS
rule_5.description: Front boundary for bedrooms only - CENTER IS OPEN
rule_5.extent: LEFT segment (0 to col B) + RIGHT segment (col D to end)
rule_5.note: NO WALL in center - living connects to porch

rule_6.name: TWIN_WET_DIVIDER
rule_6.description: Divides bathroom from wet kitchen within left-back zone

LIVING_DINING_PORCH.rule: NO interior walls within this zone
LIVING_DINING_PORCH.bounds: From row 5 wall to front, between col B and col D

D1_MAIN.location: Front exterior wall, centered on porch

D2_BEDROOMS.location: On vertical wall facing living hall

D3_BATHROOM.location: On back horizontal wall, near corner

confidence_scoring.high_0.9+: Direct from Vision API (grid lines, room labels)
confidence_scoring.medium_0.7-0.9: Preset rule applied with Vision AI validation
